name: ASC Training Center (formerly Auburn Ski Club)
note: ACTION: call (530) 426-3313 and ask whether ASC still rents XC ski gear to day visitors. The site was rebuilt since the Pass A crawl (no longer under maintenance) and the Nordic Center page now covers trails, hours, night skiing and season passes (Child $79 / Adult $260 / Senior $220 / ASC Parent $135) with NO gear-rental offering anywhere on the site; the FAQ answers waxing, sledding, dogs and race days but never rentals. This contradicts the EC review of 2026-07-05 (operator-confirmed rentals alongside the facility fee), so it is a human-verified fact vs current-site conflict, not a disproved hint. Recall rule: parked for review rather than removed.

name: Galena Sports
note: ACTION: call Galena Sports for a current rate card, or confirm a first-party site exists. galenasports.com does not resolve and no first-party website is linked from any source; the only rental evidence is third-party (Yelp, skisite.com) quoting roughly $16/day ski and snowboard packages and $13 snowshoes. Third-party review pricing is not first-party inventory, so nothing is extractable without a site or a call. Rentals are not in doubt; only the inventory source is.

name: Bobo's Ski & Patio
note: Reno ski/board shop with a full daily rental fleet plus season leases. Patio furniture is the other half of the business and is out of scope. Rental clothing is explicitly unavailable, so no apparel items beyond helmets. Multi-day pricing is a rule (20% off at 5+ days), not a published multi-day rate.

items.name: Daily Ski Rental
items.description: Standard daily ski rental, 2025-26 published rate. 20% off at 5 days or more; smallest board/ski fleet size is 80cm, suitable from about age 2. Valid driver licence and credit card required.

items.name: Daily Snowboard Rental
items.description: Standard daily snowboard rental, 2025-26 published rate. The site quotes a single $35 daily rate covering both ski and snowboard. 20% off at 5 days or more.

items.name: Performance Ski Rental
items.description: Performance upgrade tier, quoted as a single $45/day upgrade rate. The site does not state separately whether the upgrade applies to snowboards.

items.name: Performance Snowboard Rental
items.description: Performance upgrade tier at $45/day. Inferred to cover snowboards because the base $35 rate is quoted for ski and snowboard together; the rate card does not break the upgrade out by discipline.

items.description: XC package daily rate, 2025-26 season.

items.name: Snowshoe Rental
items.description: Daily snowshoe rate, 2025-26 season.

items.name: Rental Helmet
items.description: Helmets are the only clothing-adjacent item currently rented; all other rental clothing is withdrawn per the site.

items.name: Season Lease - Adult Ski/Snowboard Package
items.description: Adult season lease for the full 2025-26 season. Poles are NOT included; a season pole set is $20. Ski and snowboard packages are both offered at this tier.

items.name: Season Lease - Kids Ski/Snowboard Package
items.description: Kids season lease, 2025-26 season. The site quotes two kid tiers, $99 and $139, without saying what separates them; the lower tier is recorded and the upper noted here. Poles not included, $20 extra.

name: CV Sports
note: Four Stateline NV counters (Caesars Republic, Golden Nugget, Bally's, Daggett Station). Rate cards were compared across locations and are IDENTICAL, so one item set covers the operator. Pricing is a consecutive-day table with a free 4th day, which no single price tier can express; the day-1 rate is recorded and the promo is described. Snowshoe packages are advertised but carry no published rate.

items.name: Package One - Ski
items.description: Entry-level package. Consecutive-day rates: 1 day $49, 2 $98, 3 $147, 4th day FREE, 5 $196. Rent after 2:00 pm for the following day.

items.name: Package One - Snowboard
items.description: Entry-level package; the rate card prices ski and board packages identically. 4th consecutive day free.

items.name: Package Two - Ski
items.description: Mid-tier package. 1 day $59, 2 $118, 3 $177, 4th day FREE, 5 $236.

items.name: Package Two - Snowboard
items.description: Mid-tier package, same rate as the ski equivalent. 4th consecutive day free.

items.name: Package Three - Ski
items.description: Top performance tier; the shop warns it is demanding and suited to strong skiers. 1 day $69, 2 $138, 3 $207, 4th day FREE, 5 $276.

items.name: Package Three - Snowboard
items.description: Top performance board tier, same rate as the ski equivalent. 4th consecutive day free.

items.name: Kids Package - Ski
items.description: Youth package. 1 day $39, 2 $78, 3 $117, 4th day FREE, 5 $156.

items.name: Kids Package - Snowboard
items.description: Youth board package at the same rate as the ski equivalent.

name: Donner Ski Shop
note: Soda Springs shop, est. 1961, closed for the summer but the full 2025-26 rate card is published. Sleds and snow-play toys are listed under Retail, not Rentals, and were deliberately NOT extracted. Tuning, waxing and Sno-Park permits are services, not rental inventory. Multi-day is the daily rate multiplied by days, with no discount tier. The site also rents paddleboards and kayaks, recorded as a deferred water_sports discovery.

self_heal_categories.note: Homepage section 'Paddleboard or Kayak Rentals': board or kayak with lifevest $45.00 per day, arranged by email, first come first served, restricted to Serene Lakes only. Real take-away rental inventory, deferred because water_sports has no locked vocabulary yet.

items.name: Ski Package (Skis, Boots, Poles)
items.description: Adult ski package, 2025-26 published rate. Multi-day rentals are billed at the same daily rate multiplied by the number of days, so no discounted multi-day tier exists. First come first served, no reservations. $5 military discount.

items.name: Snowboard Package (Board, Boots)

items.description: Season rentals for 2025-26 are offered via a downloadable season rental form, available until December 19 2025 and then again after the Christmas holidays. Pricing is only inside the PDF form, so no rate is recorded here.

name: Quiver Sports
note: Alterra-operated slopeside premium ski membership (skiquiver.com; the old quiversports.com domain is dead). Two-part tariff: $79/season membership plus $39/day, or $599/season unlimited. The per-day figure is recorded as the full-day price and the membership fee is described, because the schema cannot express an access-fee-plus-usage-fee model. Skis only, guests bring their own boots. Individual ski models are published with brand, model and size runs, which is unusual for this queue.

items.name: Stockli Stormrider 95 (All Mountain)
items.description: All-mountain ski, 132-95-120, 18.5m radius at 182cm. $39/day on the $79/season Pay As You Go membership, or included in the $599/season Unlimited membership. Slopeside pickup with overnight resort storage; boots not included.

items.name: Salomon QST 100 (All Mountain)
items.description: All-mountain ski, 134-100-122, 17.5m radius at 180cm. Same membership pricing as the rest of the fleet; boots not included.

items.name: Blizzard Rustler 11 (Powder)
items.description: Powder ski, 140-112-130, 19m radius at 180cm. Same membership pricing; boots not included.

items.name: Atomic Redster Q9.8 (Piste)
items.description: Piste ski, 118.8-134-84.5, 14.4m radius at 173cm. Same membership pricing; boots not included.

items.name: Rossignol Arcade 88 (High Performance)
items.description: All-conditions ski, 135-88-124, 15m radius at 178cm. Same membership pricing; boots not included.

items.name: Quiver Unlimited Season Membership
items.description: Unlimited season access to the curated ski fleet, with guaranteed model and size selection, slopeside pickup and overnight storage. The alternative Pay As You Go membership is $79 per season plus $39 per day, recorded on the individual ski rows.

name: Totally Board
note: Truckee snowboard shop since 1994. The Rentals & Repairs page confirms snowboard rentals and demos in daily and weekend options for all ability levels, but publishes NO rental rates at all; only repair and tune pricing is listed, and that is service work rather than rental inventory. Items are therefore recorded with null pricing.

name: The Village Board Shop
note: South Lake Tahoe shop with a clean three-tier package card (demo/high-performance, basic, youth) plus a la carte hardware. Demo boards come from Bataleon, Arbor, Rome, Capita, Lib Tech and GNU with Union, Bent Metal, Bataleon and Rome bindings; the basic fleet is Arbor camber boards with Salomon boots and bindings. Repairs and tunes are services and were not extracted. Multi-day pricing is a rule ($5 off per day after 3 days), not a published multi-day rate.
